sentences.text:
* * 
 ORDER

The present petition has been filed by the Manager of Aavin, who is arrayed as the fourth accused in Crime No.1 of 2024 on the file of the first respondent seeking to quash the FIR, wherein he has been charged with the offences under Sections 408, 465, 468, 471, 420, 34 and 477-A of IPC.

2. A perusal of the FIR reveals that the petitioner along with other accused persons have involved in the financial irregularities which is reflected in the enquiry report filed under Section 81 of the Tamil Nadu Co-operative Societies Act.
3. Since prima facie case has been made out in the F.I.R. and no legal grounds have been raised to quash the FIR, this Court is not inclined to interfere in the investigation process.
There are no merits in the petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 13/03/2026 04:11:18 pm )
4. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition stands dismissed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
